content.short: Swoop Exchange enables optimal swaps across chains by aggregating aggregators, bridges, and liquidity sources.
content.description: Swoop Exchange addresses the complexity of the fragmented DeFi landscape by uniting aggregators, bridges, and liquidity sources across on-chain, cross-chain, and off-chain ecosystems into a single, cohesive meta-protocol. This meta-aggregation consolidates diverse liquidity into one interface, enabling users to compare quotes and routes from multiple sources and quickly identify the best rates for swaps and the most efficient bridging paths. All of this happens without the need to manually sift through several platforms, delivering a streamlined DeFi experience.
